newsitem.title: UK: Guinness, G.Met dip, euphoria fades.
newsitem.headline: Guinness, G.Met dip, euphoria fades.

text.p: Shares in Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc dropped on Tuesday, paring Monday's sharp gains as euphoria faded on their surprise merger agreement, dealers said.

Guinness, rated a "sell" by analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson on Tuesday, was down 18-1/2p at 584 by 1156 GMT in heavy trade of 10.8 million shares, while Grand Met was down 20-1/2p at 571 in volume of just under nine million.

Analysts at SocGen also lowered their ratings on Guinness and Grand Met, to "hold" from "buy," arguing that the benefits of the merger -- particularly their presence in emerging markets -- were hard to quantify and could take a long time to show through.
